caption: Markers on the suit are seen by the camera ring, triangulated into 3D points, then fitted by inverse kinematics to give joint angles. The worked example's 10 s take holds 48,000 marker samples (576 kB raw), and the 300 samples lost to occlusion must be bridged by the solver.

spec.title: Optical capture: the 10 s take
spec.aria: Pipeline from 40 reflective markers on the suit through 12 cameras at 120 frames per second and triangulation into 48,000 samples, then inverse kinematics fitting the skeleton to output joint angles, with 300 occlusion-lost samples bridged into the fit.
